purpose: Inspect whether calendar-day targets are identifiable from recorded cumulative counters, without interpolation or an assumed volume unit.
timezone_basis: Explicit UTC reference experiment; not a claim about household local time. Thesis Europe/Istanbul protocol is unchanged.
boundary_rule: Exact timestamp or finite monotone bracketing readings within the declared span. Equal counters resolve the boundary; otherwise retain bounds.
target_rule: lower=max(0,end_lower-start_upper), upper=end_upper-start_lower. A point target exists only when lower==upper and the used source span has no invalid counters, clock conflicts or observed counter decreases.
interior_gap_rule: Interior sampling gaps are reported. Cumulative differences can span them conditional on counter continuity; they are never filled with zero or interpolated.
assumptions: Within a usable segment the counter is cumulative and nondecreasing, with no unrecorded reset, rollover, unit change or meter replacement.
Recorded epoch timestamps describe the source observation clock; physical clock accuracy and historic provider arrival times remain unverified.
Exact means identifiable in the recorded counter representation, not metrologically exact physical consumption.
availability_rule: The label uses the first required reading at or after the day end; sample-clock availability is reported separately from the actual archive receipt.
